lines: Get down, get down, it's right past the doorway!
Hey, drop to the floor now. It's looking this way.
Don't look up. Seriously, don't look up the stairwell.
Nope, nope, it's coming back. Get behind the crates!
Everybody freeze! It's turning around right by the relay box, guys.
Lights off, lights off! It can see that glow from here.
It's right by the open door, so close! Don't you dare breathe.
I know you're scared, me too. Just stay down and be quiet.
Stop moving! I swear I saw it at the junction.
Go left, it went right. Move, come on!
Okay, it's gone for now. Don't get up yet, though.
Ugh, my shoulder's killing me, but I'm not moving an inch.
Whoever dropped that cold can, pick it up before it hears us.
Quit waving the flashlight around, the beam's bouncing everywhere!
Flashlight off, please, it's right there. I'm begging you.
Don't run! It can hear feet slapping on the metal grating.
Get behind the lockers before it turns this way, please.
It's in the next room, poking around the broken console. Shh, okay?
It came down the stairs and went right. Thank goodness.
Something's lurking by the far wall. It hasn't spotted us yet, phew.
I can hear it crawling along the ceiling pipes. Don't look.
Eyes on the floor, friend. It's in the corridor and way too close.
Get behind the crates, quick! It might swing back for another pass.
I saw it at the junction, heading away from us. Okay, breathe.
It ducked into the storage room on the right. Stay put, please.
I can see its shape behind the frosted glass. Don't you dare move!
Hush, it's sniffing the air by the ladder. Hold your breath.
The radar's going nuts, and it's right next to us, guys.
Stop poking the radar, you'll make it worse for all of us.
Careful, it's lounging by the breaker box, right in the middle.
Something's moving on the catwalk above us. I can't look.
Ugh, that music box is playing close by. I hate that tune!
The carousel tune just stopped, and that's never good. Move slow.
Its head turned a little toward the stairs. Don't you flinch, okay?
Crawl into the vent now, go, it's in the hall! Hurry!
Cover the flashlight with your hand, I swear it's close.
My flashlight's glowing like a lighthouse. Turn yours off, quick.
Who has the taser? Get ready, it's right by the door.
Don't grab the crowbar yet. Let it pass first, okay?
That axe clangs like a dinner bell, so hands off for now!
Put the stim pack away, that wrapper crinkles way too loud.
Put the lockpick down, that scratching is loud as a fire alarm.
It went left toward the stairs. Stay down, you hear me?
Okay, it went right past the crates. I think it's gone.
I think it's gone, but give it a few more seconds, please.
Wait for the footsteps to fade, then we tiptoe out single file, okay?
Stay crouched until it's out of the corridor, got it?
The others are hiding in the locker room. Shh, everybody.
Count to five with me, four, three, it's leaving now.
Footsteps again! Get under the table, right now!
It's dragging something, but it went the other way. Breathe.
I can hear it scraping the metal grate. My heart's pounding.
Leave the ladder alone, it'll hear every rung you climb.
The door swung open and it went through. Don't follow it!
Don't step past the doorway, buddy, it's standing right there.
Slow breaths, everyone. It's just around the corner, that's all.
It's by the fallen light fixture. Stay out of the open, friend.
I can see it in the window reflection. Don't you turn around!
It keeps watching the stairs, so we take the back route.
Quietly now, make for the safe room. It's between us and the exit.
Slip into the shadow of the boxes and keep your head low.
Don't check the mirror, it's right behind that pillar, I think.
I hate that long shadow across the wall. Stay away from it.
I slipped on this wet floor, so step where I step, okay?
It's stuck in the pipe for now, but it'll squeeze out soon. Move!
Something's moving by the broken platform up ahead. Ugh, why me?
Back away from the edge, it's right at the drop, come on.
Hold off on the ladder, it's standing right below us, guys.
It's at the top of the stairs and it's not moving. I hate that.
Lower your head, don't let it catch your face in the light.
Flat on your belly, it's sweeping the room. Don't twitch.
Ease back slowly, that's it, it didn't turn around. Good job.
It's staring at the lockers. Don't move a muscle, I mean it.
Stop, look down, it's right behind that pillar, okay?
Hey, you two, quiet for one second, it's right there!
